prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 15-second candid night-market POV vlog with slight grain, cold-white soft focus, and no background music or subtitles. An adult woman with a high ponytail and bow wears an adult school-inspired outfit of white shirt, tie, brown skirt, and a shoulder bag while walking with an adult companion. At 0-2 seconds, show the night-market crowd, stalls, footsteps, and casual walk. At 2-6 seconds, she points excitedly at a fried stinky-tofu stall and says, "I want to try this!" At 6-15 seconds, the companion hands her a bamboo skewer and says, "Careful, it's hot." She holds it away briefly to cool it, takes a small bite, reacts to the heat, then smiles and says it is delicious. Use only environmental sound effects and keep the interaction friendly, with no simulated blowing into her mouth or romantic-partner framing.
